programs.description: Manjula, a transgender woman in Kerala, faces daily challenges in a conservative society. Her journey of self-acceptance and resilience unfolds against evolving social norms.
Xavier, a stenographer, finds himself terminated after his boss learns that he lied to him for a leave. However, when the boss learns that Xavier is a cancer patient, he regrets his decision.
Joji, a motorcycle enthusiast, is the youngest son of a well-known man named Kora Sahib. When Joji is falsely accused of murder, he tries to prove his innocence with the support of his father.
Roby, a young man, migrates to Las Vegas in hopes of earning a livelihood and starts working at a casino. Things take a turn when he loses his friend's money and struggles with mental health issues.
An old man who depends on his family is not particularly liked due to his irksome habits. It all changes when the family learns that he owns a large rubber estate.
Prathapa Verma, in his will, has bequeathed all his property to his illegitimate son, Alexander. His legitimate son and other relatives struggle to get the power of attorney by killing Alexander.
Vidyalakshmi struggles to lead a normal life with her daughter after the sudden death of her husband. However, her world transforms after meeting Preman, an auto-rickshaw driver.
Bhargavan, a criminal suffering from panic attacks that hold him back from attacking people, goes to a psychiatrist for treatment.
Ananthan Pilla murders Chacko for being an informer of his illicit business. When the police refuse to file a complaint, Chacko's son approaches a prominent family known as the Uppukandam Brothers.
Four friends end up staying in an ancestral house which is haunted by the spirit of Urmila. By the time they realise the truth about the house, things start getting worse.
Bringing the best in cinema.

When a powerful explosion occurs at the Vilayam beach seconds after Chief Minister Madhavan leaves the venue, Police Officer Rishikesh is tasked with the investigation to find the truth behind the blast.
Ramesh's mother files a case against the home minister for molesting her. After a few days, the minister is found dead and people suspect Ramesh of murdering him.
A father chooses the richer of two brothers as a suitor for his daughter. Filled with anger, the spurned brother acts like a holy man, which changes all their lives unexpectedly.
Raghu, a responsible youth, faces the wrath of the villagers as he is the son of a lazy postman. However, Raghu's life takes a turn when he encounters Yasin Mubarak, a notorious man.
Thomas and Saraswathy get married, but their parents disapprove of their relationship due to the difference in religion. Influenced by their families, the couple gets separated after giving birth.
Narayanan, who gets convicted for killing his father, returns from prison to his village and works selflessly for its people. However, his vengeful relatives create obstacles for him.
Nandagopal raises his epileptic sister, Ammu, after their parents' death. He gets her married to Venu without telling him about her illness, but it comes to light soon and creates problems for them.
